project.title: Surveying Tropical Faunal Diversity via Airborne DNA Analyses
project.description: We assess the potential of airborne eDNA (airDNA) metabarcoding to characterize arthropod and vertebrate assemblages in a tropical forest. We deployed 28 high-flow air samplers across a 1.5 km2 area on Barro Colorado Island, Panama, over two consecutive 24-hour periods and sequenced captured DNA using general eukaryotic and vertebrate-specific metabarcoding primers.
